name: reserve_goal
description: A thin reserve and a near-term goal compete for the current surplus
explanation: The reserve gap plus the goal's monthly requirement exceeds available capacity; the coordinator assigns the reserve first.

name: debt_goal
description: High scheduled debt payments and a near-term goal compete for the current surplus
explanation: The Debt Agent requests review while the Goal Agent records a monthly requirement; the coordinator holds allocation pending debt review.

name: investment_goal
description: Investment readiness and an underfunded near-term goal compete for the current surplus
explanation: The Investment Agent reports ready to consider while the goal requires more than the available capacity; the coordinator defers investment.
